source.note: the box's saved outputs only (target, measured joints, applied torques, tool points, the ruler's verdicts); never a controller's internals

channels.label: Torque, highest joint, % of its cap
Speed, fastest joint, % of its limit
Lowest moving point above the floor

metrics.label: Tool tracking error
metrics.rule: RMS distance between the measured and the target tool point at the same instant, over the moving samples (grey = at rest, not counted). The box's objective is the median of this over its dev tasks.

metrics.label: Completed
metrics.rule: no crash or NaN, reaches the end, and the tool settles within 1 mm over the last 0.1 s

metrics.label: Stop error
metrics.rule: ≤ 1 mm at every stop: the distance between the mean measured and the mean target tool point over the stop's last 0.1 s

metrics.label: Torque saturation
metrics.rule: ≤ 2 % of physics samples (4 kHz) with any joint ≥ 98 % of its torque cap. The lane draws the 100 Hz record (0 flagged samples here); the gate counts every physics sample.

metrics.label: Joint limits
metrics.rule: 0 physics samples outside a position limit or above 1.05 × a velocity limit (0 of the record's samples flagged; the gate counts every physics sample)

metrics.label: Floor clearance
metrics.rule: 0 physics samples with the tool point or any link origin below the floor; the lane is the lowest moving point's height above the floor

metrics.label: Joint tracking (worst joint)
metrics.rule: RMS joint angle error over the moving samples, the worst of the six joints; the lane is the largest joint error at each sample

metrics.label: Tool lag
metrics.rule: how late the measured motion runs behind the target (joint trajectories cross-correlated, robot_msgs.compare)

metrics.label: Motor energy
metrics.rule: positive mechanical work: torque × velocity where positive, summed over joints, integrated over time (the lane is that power at the record's samples)
